correctness.rationale: The frozen proof and certificate fail at a material claimed witness. For M=(c_{3i-j}) on columns, Cartier is v ↦ M^(1/3)v^(1/3), so the rank of its square is the rank of M^(3)M, not MM^(3). The frozen rank-zero witness (3,19,25) has M=[[1+α+α²,2+α+α²],[1,-α²]], α³=α+1. Its determinant is zero, but the bottom-left entry of M^(3)M is 2α, so its genus-two rank is one. The original verifier and a separate attempted reproduction used the reversed product and cannot certify that witness. In the delivered replacement the two nonordinary witnesses are squarefree x⁵+1 and x⁵+x⁴+2, with square-zero and idempotent Cartier matrices of rank one respectively. Their h=0 follows from the harmonic determinant −(u−v)². For h>0 the disjoint complementary pairs give h≤3, and the three explicit configurations over F9 or F27 realize h=1,2,3 with ordinary residual quotient. Ordinary h=0 is a nonempty open intersection in the irreducible normalized chart, hence has a point over a finite extension of F3. A prime-to-three pullback isogeny from the fifteen elliptic and one genus-two factors preserves the group-scheme invariants. The monic quintic matrix is never zero, giving a=1 in each nonordinary genus-two case. Symmetry and slope denominators in dimension two force the remaining slopes to be 1/2. The repaired result proves the six stated profiles and all consequences without the erroneous census or witness.
residual_risks: The replacement no longer asserts the frozen F9/F27 profile histograms. Its bounded script certifies the two quintics and the twist-order regression, not the universal theorem.
The result is about the stated smooth marked type-(2,5) family and the three listed invariants, not a classification of full Ekedahl–Oort types, integral polarizations or curve isomorphism classes.

value.rationale: The corrected classification determines all simultaneous ordinary/supersingular elliptic counts and residual genus-two ranks in a natural three-parameter family. In particular two geometrically different group-scheme invariants occur at the same Jacobian rank and Newton polygon: (f,a)=(15,1) and (15,2). A factorization and an extremal example do not by themselves distinguish which such pairs are actually realized.
residual_risks: This is an attainable-profile classification, not a count of the members of each profile or a full moduli stratification by polarized group scheme.
